test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 29 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: 50 men took a dip in a water tank 40 m long and 20 m broad on a religious day. If the average displacement of water by a man is 4 m³, then the rise in the water level in the tank will be:
solution:
**Given:**

Number of men = 50

Length of the tank (L) = 40 m

Breadth of the tank (B) = 20 m

Average displacement of water by one man = 4 m³

**Formula used:**

Volume of the tank = Length × Breadth × Height

**Calculation:**

Volume displaced by 50 men = 50 × 4 = 200 m³

Volume of the tank = L × B × H

⇒ 200 = 40 × 20 × H

⇒ 200 = 800H

⇒ H = 200/800

⇒ H = 0.25 m = 25 cm

**∴ The correct answer is option 1.**
